title: action-body compile check: an unterminated regex literal in an inline body takes the warning arm, not the refusal arm, so a body that cannot compile is accepted at write (after #34980)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6964402867, item 1). It comes from the contract review of #34980 (landed at 15faf1da), nit N3.

## What happens
In the action-body compile check that #34980 added, an **unterminated regex literal** in an inline body takes the **warning** arm rather than the refusal arm. A body that cannot compile is then accepted at write, and fails only at run time. That is the failure #34884 (p1) was fixed for.

## Done when
An unterminated regex literal, and any other tokenizer error class the check routes to warning, is refused like every other compile error. A pin covers the regex case.

Sibling of #34987 (hook and job bodies). Area o3-C knows the code.
Grade: **p2 · domain:spec**. Theme: MCP authoring (agents write action bodies through the build door). It is a gap in a p1 fix, on a narrow input, so p2 rather than a p3 nit.
